description:
The Thing #25 (July 1985), Marvel Comics - Ben Grimm holds up a burning wreck. Mike Carlin story; Ron Wilson and Brett Breeding cover. 65 cent cover price.

Back cover: Young Astronaut Program "Reach for the Stars" ad with Captain America.

Condition: cover bright with light wear; back cover toned with light soiling and edge wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
